steps.npc: You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?

options.text: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.npc: Well, it's hot and full of sand.
Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.

options.text: So, what do you do here?

steps.player: So, what do you do here?

steps.npc: Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.

options.text: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
options.condition: If the player has asked any of the Al Kharid merchants about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...

steps.npc: Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.

steps.player: Maybe I should talk to him...

steps.npc: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.

options.text: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
options.condition: If the player has asked Ellis, the Shop assistant, or the Shop keeper (possibly other Al Kharid merchants as well) about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.

steps.npc: Don't pay any attention to those people.
They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
